Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Social Justice › Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections; mechanisms, laws, institutions and bodies for their protection › Digital accessibility — RPwD Act 2016 and Aadhaar e-KYC
CA Topic / Headline: Supreme Court warned of contempt if the Centre does not respond in detail to a plea that many visually challenged and low-vision persons still cannot independently complete Aadhaar face authentication, affecting e-KYC. Why it matters: RPwD Act accessibility duties, digital inclusion.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• RPwD Act 2016 replaced the PwD Act 1995 and raised specified disabilities from 7 to 21; the Centre can add more. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/printrelease.aspx?relid=155592&reg=48&lang=2
• Acid attack victims, dwarfism and muscular dystrophy were included as specified disabilities. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/printrelease.aspx?relid=155592&reg=48&lang=2
• Of 4% reserved posts, 1% each goes to blindness/low vision, deaf/hard of hearing and locomotor disability; 1% to other benchmark categories. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/9320/1/disabilitiesacta2016-49.pdf
• Section 42 requires the appropriate Government to make all public documents available in accessible formats. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/9320/1/disabilitiesacta2016-49.pdf
• Section 2(y) defines reasonable accommodation as necessary and appropriate modifications so persons with disabilities enjoy rights equally. https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2019/19177/19177_2019_36_1503_26115_Judgement_11-Feb-2021.pdf
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] Section 2(s): a person with disability has long-term physical, mental, intellectual or sensory impairment that hinders full and effective participation in society. https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2019/19177/19177_2019_36_1503_26115_Judgement_11-Feb-2021.pdf
• [Judgment] SC (2021, scribe case): reasonable accommodation lies at the heart of the RPwD Act, and individual dignity undergirds it. https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2019/19177/19177_2019_36_1503_26115_Judgement_11-Feb-2021.pdf
• [Judgment] SC (2024 INSC 858), on public-space access for visually challenged persons, treated accessibility as a general principle requiring removal of tangible and intangible barriers. https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2005/9321/9321_2005_1_1503_56986_Judgement_08-Nov-2024.pdf
• [Example] SC (May 2026) widened proceedings after the amicus noted victims forcibly administered acid were left out of 'specified disability'. https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2025/62038/62038_2025_1_44_70752_Order_04-May-2026.pdf
• [Way forward] Apply Section 42: make documents accessible and supply equipment so persons with disabilities can use public services in their preferred means of communication. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/9320/1/disabilitiesacta2016-49.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] How many specified disabilities does the RPwD Act, 2016 list, and what share of posts is reserved? (21; 4%).
[Mains 2027] Digital public infrastructure must be accessible by design. Examine with reference to Aadhaar e-KYC and the RPwD Act, 2016. (GS2, 15)
[Link] Mains 2017, 2022 (RPwD Act effectiveness), 2026 GS1 (inclusive disability policy); Prelims 2026; refined to Aadhaar face authentication.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › International Relations › Bilateral, regional and global groupings and agreements involving India or affecting its interests › ASEAN — Act East Policy and ASEAN-India Summit
CA Topic / Headline: Before leaving for Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit, the 23rd ASEAN-India summit and the 21st East Asia Summit, PM Modi said ties with ASEAN are at the "heart of India's Act East Policy". Why it matters: Act East, AITIGA review, Indo-Pacific.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• India became ASEAN Sectoral Dialogue Partner in 1992, Dialogue Partner in 1995, and summit-level partner in 2002. https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/India-ASEAN-july-2025.pdf
• Partnership became Strategic in 2012 (New Delhi Commemorative Summit) and Comprehensive Strategic in 2022, the 30th anniversary year. https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/India-ASEAN-july-2025.pdf
• Act East Policy was formally enunciated at the 12th ASEAN-India Summit and 9th East Asia Summit, Nay Pyi Taw, November 2014. https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/India-ASEAN-Relations-August-2018.pdf
• ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) was signed on 13 August 2009 under the India-ASEAN CECA framework. https://www.commerce.gov.in/files/2025-08/Commerce_AR-2024-25-English-1.pdf
• Mekong Ganga Cooperation was formed in 2000, making India the oldest partner of Lower Mekong countries. https://mea.gov.in/distinguished-lectures-detail?957=
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Data] India-ASEAN trade reached USD 128.38 billion in 2025-26; ASEAN was 10.55% of India's global trade. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2314556&reg=48&lang=2
• [Provision] MEA describes Act East around 4 Cs: Connectivity, Culture, Commerce and Capacity Building, with ASEAN as its cornerstone. https://mea.gov.in/distinguished-lectures-detail?957=
• [Counterpoint] India pressed in the AITIGA review to address injury to domestic industries and inequitable tariff liberalisation under the existing FTA. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2057216&reg=48&lang=2
• [Way forward] AITIGA review, tasked in September 2022, aims to make the pact more trade-facilitative; eight sub-committees negotiate it. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2007243&reg=48&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] At which summit and year was the Act East Policy formally enunciated? (12th ASEAN-India Summit, Nay Pyi Taw, 2014).
[Mains 2027] A decade of Act East: assess India-ASEAN economic ties in light of the AITIGA review and India's trade deficit. (GS2, 15)
[Link] Mains 2016 (Look East), 2017 (diaspora in SE Asia); Prelims 2015 (EAS), 2018 (ASEAN FTA partners), 2026 (connectivity); refined to 23rd summit.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Economy › Indian economy: planning, mobilisation of resources, growth, development and employment › Wholesale inflation — WPI series
CA Topic / Headline: Wholesale inflation rose to 12.3% in October 2026, the second consecutive month of double-digit inflation; fuel prices, led by crude petroleum and natural gas, were the main driver. Why it matters: WPI construction, cost-push inflation, monetary policy.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• Current WPI series has base 2011-12=100; it is the seventh revision, shifting the base from 2004-05. https://eaindustry.nic.in/uploaded_files/Press_Release.pdf
• WPI weights: primary articles 22.62, fuel and power 13.15, manufactured products 64.23. https://eaindustry.nic.in/uploaded_files/FAQs_on_WPI.pdf
• In the 2011-12 basket, primary articles weight rose from 20.1% to 22.6%; fuel and power fell from 14.9% to 13.2%. https://eaindustry.nic.in/uploaded_files/FAQs_on_WPI.pdf
• Crude petroleum and natural gas carry a 2.41 weight inside primary articles in WPI. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1789918&reg=3&lang=2
• WPI is compiled by the Office of Economic Adviser, Ministry of Commerce and Industry. https://eaindustry.nic.in/uploaded_files/Press_Release.pdf
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Data] WPI 2011-12 basket: 117 primary articles, 16 fuel and power items, 564 manufactured products. https://eaindustry.nic.in/uploaded_files/FAQs_on_WPI.pdf
• [Provision] WPI keeps three major groups: Primary Articles, Fuel & Power and Manufactured Products. https://eaindustry.nic.in/uploaded_files/Press_Release.pdf
• [Example] In October 2021 the WPI fuel and power index rose 8.72% in one month, showing how fuel drives wholesale inflation. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1771854&reg=48&lang=2
• [Way forward] Revise WPI weights periodically: the Office of Economic Adviser says weights reflect the economy's structure in the base year. https://eaindustry.nic.in/uploaded_files/FAQs_on_WPI.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Which major group carries the highest weight in WPI (2011-12=100)? (Manufactured products, 64.23%).
[Mains 2027] Distinguish WPI and CPI inflation. Why can fuel-led wholesale inflation persist even when the RBI targets retail inflation? (GS3, 10)
[Link] Prelims 2020 (CPI vs WPI weights); Mains 2024 (food inflation, monetary policy); refined to 12.3% October 2026 WPI.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Science & Technology › IT, space, computers, robotics, nanotechnology, biotechnology, intellectual property rights › Gaganyaan — astronaut training
CA Topic / Headline: Explainer on how ISRO selected and trained Gaganyaan astronaut-designates Shubanshu Shukla, Prashanth Balakrishnan Nair, Ajit Krishnan and Angad Prathap, building indigenous crew-training and bioastronautics capability. Why it matters: human spaceflight, BAS 2035.

• Gaganyaan will launch a crew of 3 to a 400 km orbit for a 3-day mission, landing in Indian sea waters. https://www.isro.gov.in/Gaganyaan.html
• Gaganyaan was approved in January 2019; revised in September 2024 to ₹20,193 crore covering 8 missions. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2299421&amp=&reg=48&amp=&lang=2
• Bharatiya Antariksh Station: five modules; base module BAS-01 targeted by 2028, full station by 2035. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2198267&reg=3&lang=2
• Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC) is ISRO's lead centre for the Gaganyaan programme. https://www.isro.gov.in/Gaganyaan.html
• Four IAF pilots selected as astronaut-designates completed training in Russia before mission-specific training in India. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2127312&reg=48&lang=2

• [Provision] HSFC R&D covers life support systems, human factors engineering, bioastronautics, crew training, and human rating and certification. https://www.isro.gov.in/Gaganyaan.html
• [Data] Programme includes two uncrewed missions and one crewed mission; it entered its final phase in 2025. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2026/jun/doc2026621898801.pdf
• [Example] Indigenous Bharatiya Docking System enables missions such as BAS, Chandrayaan-4 and Gaganyaan. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2026/jun/doc2026621898801.pdf

[Prelims 2027] Gaganyaan aims to place how many astronauts in what orbit for how long? (Three; 400 km; three days).
[Mains 2027] Discuss the significance of Gaganyaan and the Bharatiya Antariksh Station for India's space capability and microgravity research. (GS3, 10)

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Economy › Infrastructure: energy, ports, roads, airports, railways › Sustainable aviation fuel — SAF policy and Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam
CA Topic / Headline: Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam, 2026 replaces the Aircraft Rules, 1937 from 1 January 2027; a draft National SAF Policy proposes mandatory blending for international flights of 1% (2027) rising to 5% (2030). Why it matters: aviation regulation, decarbonisation, CORSIA.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 (Act 16 of 2024) received assent on 11 December 2024 and repealed the Aircraft Act, 1934. https://www.civilaviation.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-05/bharatiya-vayuyan-adhiniyam-2024-2_0.pdf
• The Adhiniyam came into force on 1 January 2025. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2089984
• Indicative SAF blending in ATF for international flights: 1% in 2027, 2% in 2028 and 5% in 2030. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2255021&reg=3&lang=1
• SAF-blended fuel was brought under the ATF (Regulation of Marketing) Order, 2001 by notification of 17 April 2026. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2255021&reg=3&lang=1
• India did not join CORSIA's voluntary phases; offsetting for Indian carriers starts from 2027. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1909435
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] The Adhiniyam aligns aviation law with the Chicago Convention and ICAO, simplifies licence issuance and adds provisions for appeals. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2123537&reg=48&lang=2
• [Data] ICAO LTAG report: SAF, lower carbon aviation fuels and cleaner energies may deliver up to 55% of aviation CO2 cuts by 2050. https://www.icao.int/sites/default/files/APAC/Meetings/2025/2025%20DGCA60/Agenda%20Item07-Aviation%20and%20Environment/60-DP-07-06%20FOSTERING%20SUSTAINABLE%20AVIATION%20FUELS%20COMMERCIALIZATION%20IN%20THE%20APAC%20REGION.pdf
• [Example] MoCA released an SAF feasibility study for India with ICAO and EU support; India was among ten ICAO states studied. https://www.icao.int/sites/default/files/environmental-protection/Documents/ACT-SAF/Feasibility_Study_India.pdf
• [Way forward] Use of SAF can reduce airlines' CORSIA offsetting requirements once the mandatory phase begins in 2027. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2255021&reg=3&lang=1
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Which Act did the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 repeal? (Aircraft Act, 1934).
[Mains 2027] Sustainable aviation fuel is key to decarbonising aviation. Examine India's SAF targets, feedstock constraints and CORSIA obligations. (GS3, 15)

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Economy › Indian economy: planning, mobilisation of resources, growth, development and employment › Liberalised Remittance Scheme — FEMA and rupee outflows
CA Topic / Headline: RBI reportedly proposed a ₹50 lakh sub-limit for discretionary categories within the USD 250,000 annual LRS cap, exempting education and medical remittances, to curb dollar outflows as the rupee fell over 4% in 2026. Why it matters: capital account management, rupee.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• All resident individuals, including minors, may freely remit up to USD 2,50,000 per financial year for permissible current or capital account transactions. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=124607&reg=48&lang=2
• The LRS limit was raised to USD 2,50,000 from USD 1,25,000. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=124607&reg=48&lang=2
• Finance Act 2023 raised TCS on LRS remittances from 5% to 20%, under Section 206C(1G) of the Income-tax Act. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1936105&reg=48&lang=2
• Budget 2026-27 proposed cutting TCS on LRS remittances for education and medical purposes from 5% to 2%. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2026/feb/doc202621775901.pdf
• Under the FEM (Current Account Transactions) Rules, 2000, private visits, gifts, employment abroad and emigration fall within the USD 2,50,000 limit. https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/20117/42998/Foreign-Exchange-Management-Current-Account-Transactions_2025-12-27_04-39-38_235e84_en.pdf/01bf7197-c654-ad60-26fc-31725fd68393?version=2.0&t=1768290152009
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] TCS applies to LRS remittances above ₹10 lakh and is collected by the authorised dealer dealing in foreign exchange. https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/20117/42998/Tax-Collection-at-Source-TCS_2026-01-19_06-07-07_032f98_en.pdf/559b833b-b571-7608-835e-62b913d4c3a6
• [Provision] Authorised dealers may allow remittances above USD 2,50,000 on estimates from an educational institution or hospital abroad. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=124607&reg=48&lang=2
• [Example] International debit or credit card payments up to ₹7 lakh a year were excluded from LRS limits and TCS. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1925592&reg=3&lang=2
• [Way forward] Government kept beneficial TCS treatment for education and health payments; any LRS sub-limit should likewise exempt these needs. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1925592&reg=3&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Under LRS, a resident individual may remit up to how much per financial year? (USD 2,50,000).
[Mains 2027] Should India tighten the Liberalised Remittance Scheme to defend the rupee? Discuss trade-offs with capital account liberalisation. (GS3, 10)

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Social Justice › Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections; mechanisms, laws, institutions and bodies for their protection › Transgender rights — 2026 amendment, NALSA
CA Topic / Headline: The Hindu analysis: transgender electors fell 31.4%, from 45,610 to 31,300, in States analysed after the SIR, below their enrolment in the 2019 Lok Sabha polls; every third transgender elector was deleted. Why it matters: NALSA, 2019 Act, electoral inclusion.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• NALSA v. Union of India, decided 15 April 2014, recognised transgender persons as 'third gender' with a right to self-identify gender. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2191532&reg=3&lang=2
• Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 came into effect on 10 January 2020. https://socialjustice.gov.in/common/47564
• Section 2(k) defines a transgender person as one whose gender does not match that assigned at birth. https://socialjustice.gov.in/common/47564
• Section 5: a transgender person applies to the District Magistrate for a certificate of identity. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/13091/1/a2019-40.pdf
• National Council for Transgender Persons was constituted under the 2019 Act by notification of 21 August 2020. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2191532&reg=3&lang=2
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] Section 4(2): a person recognised as transgender has a right to self-perceived gender identity. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/13091/1/a2019-40.pdf
• [Provision] Section 6(2): the gender of a transgender person shall be recorded in all official documents per the certificate of identity. https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/TG%20bill%20gazette.pdf
• [Judgment] SC (2025 INSC 1248) noted the 2019 Act was enacted in furtherance of NALSA to prohibit discrimination and confer self-perceived identity. https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2023/47647/47647_2023_7_1502_65077_Judgement_17-Oct-2025.pdf
• [Way forward] Use the National Portal for Transgender Persons, an end-to-end online process, for certificates and ID cards as per self-perceived identity. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1675629&reg=3&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] In which year did the Supreme Court recognise transgender persons as a 'third gender' in NALSA v. Union of India? (2014).
[Mains 2027] Electoral roll revisions risk excluding transgender electors. Examine in light of NALSA (2014) and the Transgender Persons Act, 2019. (GS2, 10)
[Link] Mains 2026 (self-identity and privacy under Article 21); refined to SIR deletions of transgender electors.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › International Relations › Effect of policies and politics of developed and developing countries on India's interests; Indian diaspora › Export controls — US AI chip rules, Wassenaar and SCOMET
CA Topic / Headline: US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security issued an interim final rule requiring licences for advanced chips to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil, to stop Chinese firms using third-country data centres for remote access; China protested. Why it matters: tech controls, India's chip ambitions.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• India joined MTCR in June 2016, the Wassenaar Arrangement in December 2017 and the Australia Group in January 2018. https://www.mea.gov.in/05-disarmament-and-international-security-affairs-overview
• India became the 42nd Wassenaar participating State and the 43rd Australia Group partner. https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/Images/S-AC-44-2019-7-E-India-UNSC-1540-2019-Report.pdf
• India became MTCR's 35th member on 27 June 2016. https://www.mea.gov.in/press-releases.htm?dtl/26953/
• SCOMET (Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies) governs export of dual-use and nuclear-related items, Chapter 10 of FTP 2023. https://content.dgft.gov.in/Website/dgftprod/a2f58730-df83-49df-a437-b5f6345abb66/FTP2023_Chapter10.pdf
• India Semiconductor Mission was approved in December 2021 with a ₹76,000 crore outlay. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2224839&reg=3&lang=1
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] India has harmonised its export control guidelines and lists with NSG and with MTCR, Wassenaar and Australia Group control lists. https://content.dgft.gov.in/Website/dgftprod/a2f58730-df83-49df-a437-b5f6345abb66/FTP2023_Chapter10.pdf
• [Example] DGFT's 2024 SCOMET update made the Department of Defence Production the licensing authority for Category 6 exports for military end use. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?relid=259260&reg=3&lang=2
• [Data] ISM offers fiscal support up to 50% for fabs, compound semiconductor and assembly units; 10 projects worth ₹1.60 lakh crore approved by December 2025. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2224839&reg=3&lang=1
• [Way forward] India's chip market is projected at USD 100-110 billion by 2030; domestic fabs reduce exposure to others' export controls. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2025/sep/doc202591625401.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] India joined the Wassenaar Arrangement in which year? (December 2017, as 42nd participating State).
[Mains 2027] How do tightening global export controls on advanced chips affect India's semiconductor mission and strategic autonomy? (GS2, 15)
[Link] Mains 2025 (semiconductor hub challenges); Prelims 2026 (semiconductor plants); refined to US remote-access chip rule.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Internal Security › Security forces and agencies and their mandate › Space security — doctrine, ASAT and PAROS
CA Topic / Headline: Op-ed argues India needs a comprehensive space security doctrine as military and civilian dependence on space grows: it must define what counts as an attack on space systems and build resilience across satellites, operators and ground infrastructure. Why it matters: space warfare, deterrence, norms.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• Mission Shakti, India's first ASAT test, was conducted on 27 March 2019 from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1671442&reg=3&lang=2
• DRDO's interceptor, a three-stage missile with two solid rocket boosters, hit a live Indian satellite in LEO in hit-to-kill mode. https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1569563
• Mission Shakti made India the fourth nation, after the USA, Russia and China, with such capability. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1570135&reg=48&lang=2
• DRDO describes space as the 4th dimension of warfare. https://www.drdo.gov.in/mission-shakti
• India and Russia called for strengthening cooperation in the UN Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space (COPUOS). https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1584171&reg=48&lang=2
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] MEA: India opposes weaponisation of outer space and supports considering prevention of an arms race in outer space (PAROS) within the UN. https://www.mea.gov.in/images/pdf/260507-India-and-the-UN-07-05-2026.pdf
• [Example] DRDO notes satellites closing in under controlled conditions replicate manoeuvring accuracy needed in future space wars, though no weapons were used. https://www.drdo.gov.in/drdo/sites/default/files/drdo_news/NPC04June2025.pdf
• [Data] BRICS New Delhi Declaration stressed space debris mitigation for long-term sustainability of outer space activities. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2309505&amp=&lang=1&amp=&reg=3
• [Way forward] India backs legally binding measures, transparency and confidence-building measures (TCBMs) and long-term sustainability guidelines on PAROS. https://www.mea.gov.in/images/pdf/260507-India-and-the-UN-07-05-2026.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Mission Shakti (2019) destroyed a satellite in which orbit, and from which site? (Low Earth Orbit; Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha).
[Mains 2027] Why does India need a space security doctrine? Discuss threats to space assets, counter-space capability and India's stand on PAROS. (GS3, 15)
[Link] first appearance — no PYQ yet

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Economy › Inclusive growth and issues arising from it › Microfinance — RBI regulatory framework and pseudo-consent
CA Topic / Headline: Explainer on RBI's firm stand on microfinance: a Deputy Governor distinguished mindful consent from pseudo-consent, asking lenders to give the Key Facts Statement, explain it in the borrower's language and get acknowledgement; over-indebtedness rising as inflation squeezes incomes. Why it matters: inclusion vs borrower protection.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• RBI caps monthly loan repayment obligations at 50% of monthly household income to protect borrowers from over-indebtedness. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2152632&reg=48&lang=2
• RBI simplified the microfinance loan definition and removed limits on loan amount per cycle and minimum tenure for NBFC-MFIs. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2152632&reg=48&lang=2
• The earlier rule that at least 50% of loans be for income generation was dropped, recognising medical and educational credit needs. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2152632&reg=48&lang=2
• RBI set up the Y.H. Malegam Sub-Committee in October 2010 after the Andhra Pradesh microfinance crisis. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=77626&reg=48&lang=2
• RBI issued the regulatory framework for NBFC-MFIs on 2 December 2011. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=87434&reg=48&lang=2
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Committee] Malegam Committee: create NBFC-MFIs regulated by RBI; margin cap 10% for portfolios over ₹100 crore, 12% for smaller; 24% interest cap. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=77626&reg=48&lang=2
• [Provision] RBI's Fair Practice Code bars NBFCs from exorbitant interest and harassment, such as calls at odd hours or muscle power for recovery. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=67461&reg=48&lang=2
• [Example] Industry bodies Sa-Dhan and MFIN launched initiatives to strengthen compliance and limit borrower indebtedness. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2152632&reg=48&lang=2
• [Way forward] NABARD and RBI have set up 2,421 financial literacy centres; expand literacy so borrowers give informed, not pseudo, consent. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2152632&reg=48&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] RBI caps a household's monthly loan repayment obligations at what share of monthly household income? (50%).
[Mains 2027] Is India's microfinance sector trading borrower protection for loan growth? Examine RBI's 2022 framework and the problem of pseudo-consent. (GS3, 15)
[Link] Mains 2013 (SHG-MFI accountability), 2020 (microfinance as anti-poverty vaccine), 2021 (women SHGs); Prelims 2021 (WaterCredit); refined to pseudo-consent.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Social Justice › Social sector and services: health, education, human resources › Measles-rubella elimination — UIP and MR campaign
CA Topic / Headline: The U.S. lost its measles-free status as the virus spread, largely among the unvaccinated, at the highest rate in over 30 years; Mexico and Bolivia also lost measles-elimination status. Why it matters: vaccine hesitancy, India's MR elimination goal.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• Under UIP, two free MR vaccine doses are given at 9-12 months and 16-24 months of age. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2124032&reg=3&lang=2
• National Zero Measles-Rubella Elimination Campaign 2025-26 was launched in World Immunization Week (24-30 April). https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2124032&reg=3&lang=2
• India set a goal to eliminate measles and rubella by 2026. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2124032&reg=3&lang=2
• MR campaign (from February 2017) targeted about 41 crore children aged 9 months to under 15 years. https://nhm.gov.in/index1.php?lang=1&level=2&sublinkid=824&lid=220
• UIP covers 9 diseases nationally, including measles and rubella, and 3 sub-nationally. https://nhm.gov.in/index1.php?lang=1&level=2&sublinkid=824&lid=220
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Data] MR campaign began in five States/UTs (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Goa, Lakshadweep), covering nearly 3.6 crore children. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=158067&reg=48&lang=2
• [Provision] Campaign gave one MR dose to all children aged 9 months to under 15 years, irrespective of prior vaccination or disease status. https://www.who.int/india/news-room/detail/11-07-2017-india-launches-one-of-the-world-s-largest-vaccination-campaigns-against-measles-and-rubella-syndrome-with-who-support
• [Example] Rubella in early pregnancy can cause Congenital Rubella Syndrome, so MR vaccination also protects the next generation. https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/searo/india/health-topic-pdf/measles/measles-rubella-vaccine-guidelines.pdf
• [Way forward] Health Minister: keep IDSP surveillance active and target MR elimination as polio and maternal-neonatal tetanus were eliminated. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2124032&reg=3&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Under UIP, the two doses of Measles-Rubella vaccine are given at what ages? (9-12 months and 16-24 months).
[Mains 2027] Measles has returned in countries that had eliminated it. What lessons does this hold for India's Measles-Rubella elimination campaign? (GS2, 10)
[Link] first appearance — no PYQ yet

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Social Justice › Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections; mechanisms, laws, institutions and bodies for their protection › Forest Rights Act 2006 — 20 years, titles and Gram Sabha
CA Topic / Headline: Tribal Affairs Ministry launched a National FRA Digital Platform during Janjatiya Gaurav Pakhwada 2026 to mark 20 years of the Forest Rights Act; 25.42 lakh titles over nearly 238 lakh acres distributed by August 2026, Chhattisgarh leading. Why it matters: tribal rights, CFR.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• FRA 2006 is Act No. 2 of 2007, dated 29 December 2006. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/8311/1/a2007-02.pdf
• Other traditional forest dweller: resided for at least three generations before 13 December 2005; one generation means 25 years. https://tribal.nic.in/fra/data/frarulesbook.pdf
• Forest-dwelling STs must be STs in the area and have primarily resided in forest land before 13-12-2005. https://tribal.nic.in/FRA/data/FAQ.pdf
• Ministry of Tribal Affairs is the nodal agency for implementing FRA. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=103784
• The Bill was introduced in Lok Sabha on 13 December 2005 and reviewed by a Joint Committee of both Houses. https://tribal.nic.in/downloads/Statistics/AnnualReport/AR2006-07.pdf
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] FRA recognises the right to hold and live in forest land for habitation or self-cultivation and to own and use minor forest produce. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=108222&reg=48&lang=2
• [Data] By December 2019, 42,48,473 claims were filed and 19,79,052 titles distributed, including 76,202 community titles. https://tribal.nic.in/downloads/FRA/MPR/2019/(A)%20-%20MPR%20Dec%202019.pdf
• [Committee] NCST 4th Report: moving the cut-off from 25 October 1980 to 13 December 2005 widened coverage of forest dwellers. https://tribal.nic.in/downloads/NCST_Report/2.pdf
• [Way forward] MoTA national meeting: FRA only recognises pre-existing rights; ensure inclusion of other traditional forest dwellers in implementation. https://tribal.nic.in/FRA/data/NationalmeetingonFRA.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] An OTFD under FRA must have resided in forests for how long before 13 December 2005? (Three generations, i.e., 75 years).
[Mains 2027] Twenty years of the Forest Rights Act: assess implementation gaps in individual and community rights and the role of the Gram Sabha. (GS2, 15)
[Link] Prelims 2013 (authority to initiate), 2018 (critical wildlife habitat), 2019, 2021 (nodal ministry); refined to FRA at 20 and digital platform.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Governance › Government policies and interventions for development; issues in design and implementation › RERA 2016 — ten years and homebuyer protection
CA Topic / Headline: Ten years after the RERA Act, 2016, homebuyers' forum FPCE proposed moving homebuyer protection to the Department of Consumer Affairs, a single national appellate tribunal and a statutory model Agreement for Sale; the Centre asked the SC to expedite a case on uniform builder-buyer agreements. Why it matters: regulation, consumer rights.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• Projects with land above 500 sq m or more than 8 apartments must register with the Real Estate Regulatory Authority. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/17773/1/the_real_estate_(regulation_and_development)_act,_2016.pdf
• Section 4 requires 70% of amounts realised from allottees in a separate bank account for construction and land cost. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1810454&reg=3&lang=2
• RERA was passed in March 2016; some sections came into force on 1 May 2016 and the rest on 1 May 2017. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2021/nov/doc202111121.pdf
• Each State/UT must set up its own Real Estate Regulatory Authority, Appellate Tribunal and Adjudicating Officers. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2021/nov/doc202111121.pdf
• Appellate Tribunal is established under Section 43 of the Act. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/2158/3/A2016-16.pdf
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] Developers and buyers pay the same penal interest, SBI's MCLR plus 2%, in case of delays. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=161408&reg=48&lang=2
• [Data] 28 States/UTs had set up Real Estate Appellate Tribunals and 30 had set up Regulatory Authorities. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1810454&reg=3&lang=2
• [Example] RERA applies to residential and commercial real estate, and to both private and public bodies engaged in sale. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2022/apr/doc20224636701.pdf
• [Way forward] RERA requires cases to be decided within sixty days of application; enforce this timeline for speedy dispute redressal. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2021/nov/doc202111121.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Under RERA, what share of money collected from allottees must be kept in a separate bank account? (70%).
[Mains 2027] A decade of RERA: has it rebalanced the relationship between builders and homebuyers? Suggest reforms. (GS2, 10)
[Link] first appearance — no PYQ yet

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Disaster Management › Disaster and disaster management › Cyclones — IMD naming and warnings
CA Topic / Headline: Severe cyclonic storm Akvan altered its trajectory; it is expected to make landfall between Narsapur in A.P. and Puri in Odisha, putting north A.P. and Odisha on alert; experts attribute the uncertainty to El Nino and mid-level moisture. Why it matters: track forecasting, preparedness.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• IMD classes: depression 31-49 kmph, deep depression 50-61, cyclonic storm 62-88, severe cyclonic storm 89-117 kmph. https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/images/pdf/sop.pdf
• Very severe cyclonic storm 64-89 knots, extremely severe 90-119 knots, super cyclonic storm 120 knots and above. https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/images/pdf/faq.pdf
• RSMC New Delhi names a North Indian Ocean cyclone once its maximum sustained wind reaches 34 knots (62 kmph). https://internal.imd.gov.in/press_release/20200428_pr_788.pdf
• Naming over the North Indian Ocean began in 2004 (first name Onil); names are used sequentially, column-wise. https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/images/pdf/Souvenir_RSMC_17Aug.pdf
• WMO/ESCAP Panel adopted a new name list in April 2020; it includes Arnab (Bangladesh), Murasu (India) and Akvan (Iran). https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/images/pdf/tc-names.pdf
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] IMD standard operating procedure links each cyclone class to expected damage and action, such as total suspension of fishing operations. https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/images/pdf/sop.pdf
• [Data] A cyclonic storm of 62-88 kmph causes damage to thatched huts and breaks tree branches; a severe storm extensively damages thatched roofs and power lines. https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/images/pdf/sop.pdf
• [Example] RSMC New Delhi names tropical cyclones forming over the North Indian Ocean, including the Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea, from the agreed Panel list. https://internal.imd.gov.in/press_release/20200428_pr_788.pdf
• [Way forward] IMD FAQ: cyclone intensity and size are only weakly associated, so category alone does not show the area at risk; read warnings with track forecasts. https://rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/images/pdf/faq.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] IMD classes a storm with sustained winds of 89-117 kmph as? (Severe cyclonic storm).
[Mains 2027] Why do Bay of Bengal cyclone tracks change abruptly? Discuss forecasting limits and their implications for evacuation planning. (GS1, 10)
[Link] Mains 2013 (naming), 2022 (warnings), 2024, 2026; Prelims 2020; refines the 16 Nov entry on Akvan.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Science & Technology › Achievements of Indians in S&T; indigenisation of technology › Air defence — Barak-8 MRSAM and LRSAM
CA Topic / Headline: Defence Ministry signed a ₹1,976.40 crore contract with Israel Aerospace Industries to upgrade and manage obsolescence of the Barak Point Defence Missile System on Indian Navy warships, under the Other Capital Procurement Procedure. Why it matters: naval air defence, India-Israel defence ties.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• LR-SAM (ship-launched) and MR-SAM (land-launched) are versions of Barak-8, jointly developed by DRDO and Israel Aerospace Industries. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1481713
• MR-SAM detects aircraft over 100 km away and destroys them at ranges up to 70 km. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1481713
• DRDL Hyderabad co-developed MRSAM; Bharat Dynamics Limited manufactures it. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1572157&reg=3&lang=2
• Navy's first cooperative MRSAM engagement used INS Kochi and INS Chennai, one ship controlling both ships' missiles (May 2019). https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1572157&reg=3&lang=2
• MRSAM Army system has a command post, multi-function radar and mobile launchers. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2118918&reg=48&lang=2
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Data] In 2023, five MRSAM firing units and a training centre were commissioned in the IAF. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1989502&reg=48&lang=2
• [Example] Navy MRSAM gives point and area defence to P15A ships against fighters, missiles and other aerial threats. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1989502&reg=48&lang=2
• [Example] DRDO lists Barak-8, S-400, Akash and the Integrated Counter-UAS Grid as the aerial shield that held in Operation Sindoor. https://drdo.gov.in/drdo/sites/default/files/drdo_news/NPC_OP_Sindoor07Mayto31May2025.pdf
• [Way forward] Indian industries such as BEL, L&T, BDL and Tata contributed MRSAM subsystems; widen domestic supply for upgrades and spares. https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=146658&reg=3&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] MRSAM and LRSAM, versions of Barak-8, were jointly developed by DRDO and which firm? (Israel Aerospace Industries).
[Mains 2027] Layered air defence is central to modern warfare. Discuss India's air defence systems and the role of co-development with partners. (GS3, 10)
[Link] Mains 2021 (S-400 air defence); Prelims 2018 (THAAD); refined to Barak upgrade contract.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Science & Technology › Developments in science and technology and their applications in everyday life › Cancer early detection — AI blood test and NP-NCD screening
CA Topic / Headline: An AI-based blood test using DNA sequencing to spot changes in DNA that indicate multiple cancers was validated with 1,480 participants in 43 hospitals across India over four years; findings were published in PNAS. Why it matters: early detection, indigenous diagnostics.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• ICMR set up the National Cancer Registry Programme (NCRP) in 1982. https://www.icmr.gov.in/icmrobject/custom_data/1702893085_icmr_press_release_ncrp_18082020.pdf
• ICMR estimated more than 14 lakh cancer cases in India in 2023. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2102729&reg=48&lang=2
• NP-NCD screens persons over 30 for common NCDs, including oral, breast and cervical cancer. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2243768&amp=&reg=48&amp=&lang=2
• National Institute of Cancer Prevention & Research (NICPR) is the nodal agency for research and screening guidelines. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2102729&reg=48&lang=2
• In February 2026 a three-month campaign offered free HPV vaccine to 1.2 crore girls aged 14. https://www.pib.gov.in/FactsheetDetails.aspx?Id=150834&reg=20&lang=8
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Data] Under NP-NCD, 8.73 crore women were screened for cervical cancer and 93,062 cases diagnosed. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2243768&amp=&reg=48&amp=&lang=2
• [Data] MoHFW: about 40% of cancers in India are related to tobacco use. https://mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/1493693747note_0.pdf
• [Provision] Health is a State subject; the Centre supplements State cancer control efforts through NHM. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1602759&reg=48&lang=2
• [Way forward] Over 80% of cervical cancers present at an advanced stage; earlier detection tools can cut late diagnosis. https://www.icmr.gov.in/icmrobject/custom_data/pdf/resource-guidelines/Consensus%20Document%20for%20The%20Management%20of%20Cancer%20Cervix_0.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Which body runs India's National Cancer Registry Programme, set up in 1982? (ICMR).
[Mains 2027] Liquid biopsy and AI diagnostics could transform cancer screening. Discuss their promise and the limits of India's current screening programme. (GS3, 10)

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Governance › Government policies and interventions for development; issues in design and implementation › Rural employment — VB-G RAM G Act 2025 grievance redress
CA Topic / Headline: Rural Development Ministry issued guidelines for ombudspersons and appellate authorities under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025: each district gets an ombudsperson for complaints on job cards, employment, wages, delayed compensation, worksite facilities and muster rolls. Why it matters: accountability in rural employment guarantee.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• VB-G RAM G Act is Act No. 36 of 2025, dated 20 December 2025. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/22478/1/a2025-36.pdf
• It guarantees 125 days of wage employment a year to rural households whose adults volunteer for unskilled manual work. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/22478/1/a2025-36.pdf
• MGNREGA stood repealed from 1 July 2026, when the new Act came into force nationwide. https://www.pib.gov.in/FaqDetails.aspx?ModuleId=4&NoteId=158511&lang=1&reg=3
• Employment must be provided within 15 days of application; the unemployment allowance provision is retained. https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/bills_parliament/2025/Summary-Viksit_Bharat_GRamG_Bill_2025.pdf
• Section 5(1) obliges the Government to provide not less than 125 days of guaranteed wage employment. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2207187&reg=3&lang=2
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] MGNREGA guaranteed at least 100 days; the new Act raises the guarantee to 125 days. https://prsindia.org/billtrack/the-viksit-bharat-%E2%80%93-guarantee-for-rozgar-and-ajeevika-mission-gramin-vb-%E2%80%93-g-ram-g-bill-2025
• [Provision] Works prioritise water security, rural infrastructure, livelihood assets and disaster preparedness through digitally integrated planning. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2026/may/doc2026511867601.pdf
• [Example] Act links wage employment with durable rural infrastructure across four priority areas. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2025/dec/doc20251222741501.pdf
• [Way forward] Government says the Act strengthens accountability and does not dilute the right to demand work; district ombudspersons must enforce timely wages. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2207187&reg=3&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 guarantees how many days of wage employment per rural household per year? (125 days).
[Mains 2027] Does the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 strengthen or dilute the right to work? Examine its grievance redress and accountability mechanisms. (GS2, 15)
[Link] Mains 2025 GS4 (MGNREGA case study); refined to VB-G RAM G ombudsperson guidelines.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Social Justice › Social sector and services: health, education, human resources › Generic medicines — PM Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
CA Topic / Headline: Reports on 19 November urged expanding PMBJP to cut high out-of-pocket medicine costs: 20,547 Jan Aushadhi Kendras operated by July 2026 against a 25,000 target for March 2027; 2,110 medicines and 315 surgical items sold 50-80% below brands. Why it matters: affordable medicines, OOPE.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• PMBJP was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, in November 2008. https://janaushadhi.gov.in/about-pmbjb
• It is implemented by Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI), formerly Bureau of Pharma PSUs of India. https://janaushadhi.gov.in/about-pmbjb
• Jan Aushadhi Kendras sell medicines about 50% to 80% cheaper than branded equivalents. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2241166&reg=3&lang=1
• Product basket: 2,110 medicines and 315 surgicals, consumables and devices. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2241166&reg=3&lang=1
• Government aims to open 25,000 Kendras by March 2027 through a franchisee-based model. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2236292&reg=3&lang=2
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Data] 18,646 Jan Aushadhi Kendras had opened by 28 February 2026. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2246069&reg=3&lang=2
• [Data] On average 10 to 12 lakh persons visit Jan Aushadhi Kendras daily. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2116220
• [Example] Over ten years, Kendras grew 180 times and sales over 200 times. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2107206&reg=48&lang=2
• [Way forward] Branded generics cost far more than unbranded equivalents of the same therapeutic value; consistent policy intervention is needed to cut treatment costs. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2236292&reg=48&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] PMBJP is implemented by which body under the Department of Pharmaceuticals? (Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India).
[Mains 2027] Can generic medicine outlets substantially cut out-of-pocket health spending in India? Evaluate PMBJP's reach and constraints. (GS2, 10)

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Governance › Governance, transparency and accountability, e-governance, citizens charters, institutional measures › Gold hallmarking — HUID and BIS Act 2016
CA Topic / Headline: BIS said more than 65 crore gold jewellery pieces had HUID numbers by 15 October 2026 and BIS-registered jewellers rose to 2,36,624, linked to wider mandatory hallmarking and digital traceability. Why it matters: consumer protection, standards.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• Mandatory hallmarking of gold jewellery and artefacts began on 23 June 2021 in 256 districts. https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/brief-on-Hallmarking.pdf
• Mandatory hallmarking now covers 392 districts after the amendment dated 3 August 2026. https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/brief-on-Hallmarking.pdf
• Hallmark comprises the BIS Standard Mark, purity in carat and fineness, and a 6-digit alphanumeric HUID. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2068947
• Only HUID-hallmarked jewellery may be sold by BIS-registered jewellers from 1 April 2023. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1912343
• Jewellers with annual turnover up to ₹40 lakh are outside mandatory hallmarking; articles under two grams are exempt. https://www.bis.gov.in/hallmarking-jewellers/?lang=en
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] Hallmarking is governed by the BIS Act 2016, BIS Rules 2018 and BIS (Hallmarking) Regulations 2018. https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/brief-on-Hallmarking.pdf
• [Provision] Sections 14 and 16 of the BIS Act 2016 enable the Centre to make hallmarking mandatory. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=1599355&reg=48&lang=2
• [Example] Consumers can verify HUID on the BIS Care App and test jewellery at any recognised AHC for ₹200. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2068947
• [Way forward] 9K hallmarking under IS 1417:2016 is voluntary; extend coverage beyond districts with assaying centres. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2239540&reg=3&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Gold hallmarking under BIS carries which three marks? (BIS Standard Mark, purity in carat and fineness, 6-digit HUID).
[Mains 2027] How has mandatory HUID-based hallmarking improved consumer protection in the gold market? Discuss remaining gaps. (GS2, 10)
[Link] Prelims 2017 (BIS Standard Mark); refined to HUID milestones.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Governance › Governance, transparency and accountability, e-governance, citizens charters, institutional measures › Surveillance pricing — dark patterns and Consumer Protection Act 2019
CA Topic / Headline: New York City Council passed a bill banning surveillance pricing, the use of personal data to set what consumers pay. Why it matters: algorithmic pricing, consumer protection and data regulation in India.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• CCPA came into existence on 24 July 2020 under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2085748&reg=3&lang=2
• CCPA issued Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns on 30 November 2023 under Section 18 of the 2019 Act. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1983994&reg=48&lang=2
• The Guidelines list 13 dark patterns, including basket sneaking, confirm shaming, forced action and false urgency. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2268302&reg=3&lang=1
• Section 2(47) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 defines unfair trade practice. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2146813
• Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 were notified under the 2019 Act. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2004520
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] CCPA can prevent consumer detriment from unfair trade practices and initiate class actions, recalls, refunds and returns. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2085748&reg=3&lang=2
• [Example] CCPA fined PhysicsWallah ₹5 lakh and McAfee ₹1 lakh for dark patterns affecting informed consumer choice. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2268302&reg=3&lang=1
• [Data] 26 leading e-commerce platforms self-declared compliance after audits for dark patterns. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2191948&reg=3&lang=2
• [Way forward] CCPA advisory (5 June 2025) asks e-commerce platforms to self-audit for dark patterns; extend scrutiny to personalised pricing. https://ccpa.doca.gov.in/guidelines.php
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] How many dark patterns are listed in CCPA's Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023? (13).
[Mains 2027] Algorithmic and data-driven pricing can exploit consumers. Is India's consumer protection framework equipped to regulate it? (GS2, 10)

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › International Relations › Bilateral, regional and global groupings and agreements involving India or affecting its interests › India-Japan — 2+2 dialogue and defence cooperation
CA Topic / Headline: India and Japan held a 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministers' dialogue in Tokyo; a Letter of Intent will, for the first time, let Japanese forces train in Indian firing ranges; they discussed India receiving the UNICORN naval radar and wider special forces exercises. Why it matters: Indo-Pacific defence ties.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• India and Japan share a Special Strategic and Global Partnership since 2014. https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/India-Japan-Bilateral-Brief-for-website.pdf
• Japan was the only country with which India had both an Annual Summit and a 2+2 ministerial mechanism; the first 2+2 was held in 2019. https://www.mea.gov.in/Uploads/PublicationDocs/32489_AR_Spread_2020_new.pdf
• RPSS between Japan's Self-Defense Forces and Indian Armed Forces was signed on 9 September 2020. https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/India-Japan-May-2025.pdf
• India-Japan ties have more than 70 bilateral dialogue mechanisms across sectors. https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/India-Japan-Bilateral-Brief-for-website.pdf
• Indian monk Bodhisena consecrated the Great Buddha at Todaiji Temple, Nara, in 752 AD. https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/India-Japan-Bilateral-Brief-for-website.pdf
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] RPSS covers supplies and services during bilateral training, UN peacekeeping and humanitarian relief, and raises interoperability. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1652911
• [Example] Japan joined the multilateral exercise MILAN for the first time, and RPSS was operationalised in March 2022. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1857778&reg=48&lang=2
• [Data] The 2022 Tokyo 2+2 marked 70 years of India-Japan diplomatic relations. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1857778&reg=48&lang=2
• [Way forward] Leaders reaffirmed a free and open Indo-Pacific underpinned by inclusiveness and rules-based order as the basis of cooperation. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1807373
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] India-Japan RPSS, signed in September 2020, concerns what? (Reciprocal provision of supplies and services between armed forces).
[Mains 2027] India-Japan defence ties are deepening under the Special Strategic and Global Partnership. Examine their drivers and limits in the Indo-Pacific. (GS2, 15)
[Link] Mains 2013 (economic ties below potential), 2019 (contemporary India-Japan relationship); refined to 2+2 firing-range pact.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › International Relations › Important international institutions, agencies and fora: structure, mandate › ICJ — Genocide Convention, The Gambia v. Myanmar
CA Topic / Headline: The ICJ ruled 9-6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in northern Rakhine during its 2017 military operation, the first time it has found a state responsible for genocide; it ordered Myanmar to allow return of those who fled. Why it matters: international law, refugees, neighbourhood.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• ICJ has 15 judges elected for nine-year terms by the UN General Assembly and Security Council; seat at the Peace Palace, The Hague. https://www.icj-cij.org/public/files/case-related/178/178-20220722-PRE-01-00-EN.pdf
• The Genocide Convention was adopted by the UN General Assembly on 9 December 1948. https://www.icj-cij.org/sites/default/files/case-related/178/178-20261119-jud-01-00-en.pdf
• The Gambia filed the case on 11 November 2019, on behalf of the 57-member OIC. https://iimm.un.org/en/icj-gambia-v-myanmar
• Jurisdiction rests on Article IX of the Genocide Convention; ICJ upheld it on 22 July 2022. https://www.icj-cij.org/sites/default/files/case-related/178/178-20261103-pre-01-00-en.pdf
• ICJ, the UN's principal judicial organ, was established by the UN Charter in June 1945. https://www.icj-cij.org/sites/default/files/case-related/178/178-20250729-pre-01-00-en.pdf
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Judgment] ICJ (19 November 2026) found Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya during 2017 'clearance operations'. https://www.icj-cij.org/sites/default/files/case-related/178/178-20261119-pre-01-00-en.pdf
• [Provision] Article 9 of the Genocide Convention lets parties take disputes on a State's responsibility for genocide to the ICJ. https://iimm.un.org/en/icj-gambia-v-myanmar
• [Example] ICJ ordered provisional measures against Myanmar on 23 January 2020, before the merits stage. https://www.icj-cij.org/sites/default/files/case-related/178/178-20261103-pre-01-00-en.pdf
• [Way forward] Reparation will be fixed later; Myanmar must report to the Court within two years of the judgment. https://www.icj-cij.org/sites/default/files/case-related/178/178-20261119-pre-01-00-en.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] The ICJ has how many judges and for what term? (15 judges; nine-year term, elected by the UNGA and UNSC).
[Mains 2027] The ICJ's Rohingya genocide ruling tests the reach of international law. Discuss its implications for India as a neighbour and host. (GS2, 10)

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Social Justice › Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections; mechanisms, laws, institutions and bodies for their protection › EPFO — systematic withdrawal plan and EPS 1995
CA Topic / Headline: EPFO's Central Board of Trustees approved a Systematic Withdrawal Plan for monthly, quarterly or half-yearly retirement payouts; minimum PF balance requirement cut from 25% to 10% and wait for final settlement reduced to two months. Why it matters: old-age income security.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• EPFO, an autonomous body under the Labour Ministry, administers the EPF & MP Act, 1952 and its schemes. https://www.labour.gov.in/static/uploads/2026/06/4b7ec0e8206aa4860576d6f75b432e97.pdf
• Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995 came into force on 16 November 1995 under Section 6A of the 1952 Act. https://www.epfindia.gov.in/site_docs/PDFs/Downloads_PDFs/EPS95.pdf
• EPS is funded by 8.33% of wages from the employer's share and 1.16% by the Central Government, subject to wage ceiling. https://pmvbry.epfindia.gov.in/pension-scheme-eps/
• EPS 1995 replaced the Employees' Family Pension Scheme, 1971. https://www.epfindia.gov.in/site_docs/PDFs/EPFO_Rules-Regulations_PDFs/Handbook_EPS1995.pdf
• CBT recommended 8.25% interest on EPF accumulations for 2025-26. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2234502&reg=3&lang=1
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] Three schemes run under the 1952 Act: EPF Scheme 1952, EPS 1995 and EDLI Scheme 1976. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2234502&reg=3&lang=1
• [Provision] Section 10 of the EPF & MP Act protects provident fund money from attachment by any court. https://pmvbry.epfindia.gov.in/faq-epfo/
• [Example] CPPS for EPS 1995 disbursed about ₹1,612 crore to more than 69 lakh pensioners in February 2025. https://www.epfindia.gov.in/site_docs/PDFs/Updates/Newsletter_January_Mar_2025_EPFO.pdf
• [Way forward] Membership continues to age 58; pension covers superannuation, early retirement, disability and family pension, so phased payouts can extend income security. https://pmvbry.epfindia.gov.in/pension-scheme-eps/
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Under EPS 1995, what share of wages from the employer's PF contribution goes to the pension fund? (8.33%).
[Mains 2027] India lacks a robust old-age income system. How do EPFO's systematic withdrawal plan and EPS 1995 address retirement security? (GS2, 10)

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Agriculture › Land reforms in India › Land acquisition — LARR Act 2013 and Gram Sabha consent
CA Topic / Headline: Supreme Court struck down land acquisition for limestone mining in Odisha's Sundargarh district (Bibol Toppo v. Odisha), holding prior Gram Sabha consent mandatory in Scheduled Areas under the 2013 land acquisition law. Why it matters: tribal rights, Fifth Schedule, LARR.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• LARR Act is Act No. 30 of 2013, dated 26 September 2013; it replaced the Land Acquisition Act, 1894. https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19895/1/the_right_to_fair_compensation_and_transparency_in_land_acquisition,_rehabilitation_and_resettlement_act,_2013..pdf
• Consent needed: 80% of affected families for private companies, 70% for PPP; none for government projects. https://prsindia.org/billtrack/the-right-to-fair-compensation-and-transparency-in-land-acquisition-rehabilitation-and-resettlement-second-amendment-bill-2015
• Section 41(3): acquisition in Scheduled Areas needs prior consent of the Gram Sabha, Panchayats or autonomous District Councils. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1579747&reg=48&lang=2
• Compensation is up to four times market value in rural areas and twice in urban areas. https://prsindia.org/billtrack/the-right-to-fair-compensation-and-transparency-in-land-acquisition-rehabilitation-and-resettlement-bill-2013
• Every acquisition requires a Social Impact Assessment and rehabilitation and resettlement for those affected. https://prsindia.org/billtrack/the-right-to-fair-compensation-and-transparency-in-land-acquisition-rehabilitation-and-resettlement-bill-2013
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] The Act seeks a humane, participative, informed and transparent acquisition process in consultation with local self-government and Gram Sabhas. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1579747&reg=48&lang=2
• [Provision] Sections 41 and 42 add special safeguards against displacement for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1579747&reg=48&lang=2
• [Counterpoint] The 2015 amendment Bill sought to exempt defence, rural infrastructure, affordable housing, industrial corridors and PPP infrastructure from SIA and consent. https://prsindia.org/billtrack/prs-products/prs-legislative-brief-2459
• [Way forward] PRS noted the five exempted categories are broad; keep SIA and consent as the default for public-purpose projects. https://prsindia.org/billtrack/prs-products/prs-legislative-brief-2459
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Under the LARR Act, 2013, acquisition for private companies needs consent of what share of affected families? (80%; 70% for PPP).
[Mains 2027] Prior Gram Sabha consent in Scheduled Areas is mandatory under the LARR Act, 2013. Discuss its significance for tribal rights and development. (GS3, 10)
[Link] Mains 2014 (LARR Act 2013 effects); refined to SC Sundargarh mining ruling.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Environment › Conservation, environmental pollution and degradation, environmental impact assessment › COP31 — fossil fuel transition and India's NDC
CA Topic / Headline: The COP31 draft cover text in Turkiye dropped references to a fossil fuel phase-out and net zero dates; developing countries pressed for phasing out unilateral trade measures such as the EU's CBAM. Why it matters: Global Stocktake follow-up, equity, India's NDC.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• Updated NDC (August 2022): cut emissions intensity of GDP 45% by 2030 from 2005 level. https://unfccc.int/sites/default/files/NDC/2022-08/India%20Updated%20First%20Nationally%20Determined%20Contrib.pdf
• NDC also targets about 50% cumulative installed power capacity from non-fossil sources by 2030. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1847813&reg=3&lang=2
• India's Panchamrit pledges at COP26, Glasgow included net-zero emissions by 2070. https://moef.gov.in/uploads/2022/11/Indias-LT-LEDS.pdf
• India submitted its first NDC on 2 October 2015. https://unfccc.int/sites/default/files/NDC/2022-08/India%20Updated%20First%20Nationally%20Determined%20Contrib.pdf
• COP28 in Dubai (30 November-13 December 2023) adopted the outcome of the first Global Stocktake. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1989495&reg=48&lang=2
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] India adheres to Equity and Common But Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities (CBDR-RC) under UNFCCC. https://netzeroindia.moef.gov.in/about
• [Data] By June 2025 India had reduced emissions intensity of GDP by around 36% from 2005. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2249751&reg=3&lang=1
• [Example] India's NDC includes the LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment) mass movement as key to combating climate change. https://unfccc.int/sites/default/files/NDC/2022-08/India%20Updated%20First%20Nationally%20Determined%20Contrib.pdf
• [Way forward] India links its 50% non-fossil target to technology transfer and low-cost international finance, including from the Green Climate Fund. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1885731&reg=48&lang=2
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] India's updated NDC (2022) targets cutting emissions intensity of GDP by how much by 2030 from 2005? (45%).
[Mains 2027] Why did COP31 struggle to agree on a fossil fuel phase-out? Discuss India's position on equity, CBDR-RC and trade measures like CBAM. (GS3, 15)
[Link] Mains 2014 (UNFCCC carbon credits), 2021 (COP26 outcomes); Prelims 2016 (Paris Agreement); refined to COP31 cover text.

Syllabus Tag: GS3 › Economy › Effects of liberalisation; changes in industrial policy and effects on industrial growth › Critical minerals — National Critical Mineral Mission
CA Topic / Headline: Op-ed: India's minerals policy must move from auctions to material security; the National Critical Mineral Mission has ₹34,300 crore over seven years, and the amended mining law allows auction of 24 critical minerals, with more blocks due before 2031. Why it matters: energy transition, supply chains.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• NCMM was approved on 29 January 2025: ₹16,300 crore expenditure plus ₹18,000 crore expected from PSUs, total ₹34,300 crore. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2097309
• NCMM runs seven years, 2024-25 to 2030-31. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2112232&reg=3&lang=2
• A November 2022 Mines Ministry committee identified 30 critical minerals; 24 are in Part D of Schedule I of the MMDR Act. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2120525&reg=3&lang=2
• MMDR Act was amended in 2023 to boost exploration and mining of critical minerals. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2097309
• KABIL, a Mines Ministry JV, acquired about 15,703 ha in Catamarca, Argentina, for lithium exploration. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2097309&amp=&lang=2&amp=&reg=48
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] NCMM covers the whole value chain: exploration, mining, beneficiation, processing and recovery from end-of-life products. https://mines.gov.in/admin/storage/ckeditor/Press_Release_Press_Information_Bureau7_1740396701.pdf
• [Data] GSI is tasked with 1,200 exploration projects from 2024-25 to 2030-31 under the Mission. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2120525&reg=3&lang=2
• [Example] Ministry of Mines has auctioned 34 critical mineral blocks. https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2025/dec/doc20251231748501.pdf
• [Way forward] NCMM aims at fast-track approvals, incentives for exploration and recovery from overburden and tailings. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2097309&amp=&lang=2&amp=&reg=48
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] How many critical minerals were identified by the Mines Ministry committee and how many placed in Part D of MMDR Schedule I? (30; 24).
[Mains 2027] Mining critical minerals is not enough without processing capacity. Discuss India's path from mineral security to material security. (GS3, 15)
[Link] Prelims 2022 (monazite, rare earths), 2025 (Minerals Security Partnership); refined to NCMM and processing.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Social Justice › Social sector and services: health, education, human resources › Antimicrobial resistance — NAP-AMR 2.0 and drug regulation
CA Topic / Headline: Health Ministry proposed amending the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019 to include antimicrobials in the definition of 'New Drug', and the Drugs Rules, 1945 to add a separate licence for bulk drug sale, amid concern over lax manufacturing licences. Why it matters: AMR, drug regulation.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• First NAP-AMR was launched on 19 April 2017, aligned with WHO's Global Action Plan, for 2017-2021. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2191165&reg=48&lang=2
• NAP-AMR 2.0 covers 2025-2029 with a One Health approach. https://www.dghs.mohfw.gov.in/uploads/assets/KXmRi1l4QdT6LYhFCyNh734zJJsO62yWzL05FVKv.pdf
• Schedule H1 (from March 2014) covers about 24 third/fourth-generation cephalosporins and carbapenems; sale needs a prescription. https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/antimicrobial-resistance/amr-spc-npm/nap-library/national-action-plan-on-amr-(india).pdf?sfvrsn=9f396e90_1&download=true
• NARS-Net, a network of State medical college labs, generates AMR data on priority bacterial pathogens. https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1896028&reg=48&lang=2
• The Delhi Declaration on AMR was signed by ministers of four ministries at the 2017 launch. https://ncdc.mohfw.gov.in/uploads/pdf/amr10.pdf
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] AMR needs a One Health approach coordinating human, animal, agriculture and environment sectors. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2191165&reg=48&lang=2
• [Data] COVID-19 stalled implementation of the first NAP-AMR during 2020-22. https://ncdc.mohfw.gov.in/uploads/pdf/amr10.pdf
• [Example] Under India's G20 presidency in 2023, AMR featured in the Leaders' Declaration. https://www.dghs.mohfw.gov.in/uploads/assets/KXmRi1l4QdT6LYhFCyNh734zJJsO62yWzL05FVKv.pdf
• [Way forward] CDSCO enforcement drives on Schedule H and H1 must continue; each sector must commit under NAP-AMR 2.0. https://www.dghs.mohfw.gov.in/uploads/assets/KXmRi1l4QdT6LYhFCyNh734zJJsO62yWzL05FVKv.pdf
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Which schedule of the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules restricts antibiotic sale to prescriptions of a Registered Medical Practitioner? (Schedule H1).
[Mains 2027] AMR is a silent pandemic. Evaluate India's regulatory response, including NAP-AMR 2.0 and tighter controls on antimicrobial approvals. (GS2, 15)
[Link] Mains 2014 (antibiotic overuse); Prelims 2019 (multi-drug resistance); refined to New Drug definition amendment.

Syllabus Tag: GS2 › Social Justice › Social sector and services: health, education, human resources › Adult literacy — ULLAS Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram
CA Topic / Headline: Vajiram & Ravi's Mains brief on ULLAS records 11 States and UTs declared fully literate under the New India Literacy Programme. Why it matters: adult education, NEP 2020 goal of full literacy.
Prelims Recall (CSE 2027):
• ULLAS (New India Literacy Programme) is a centrally sponsored scheme for FYs 2022-27, targeting non-literates aged 15 and above. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2130080&reg=48&lang=2
• Its outlay is ₹1,037.90 crore for 2022-23 to 2026-27. https://dsel.education.gov.in/en/scheme/nilp
• Five components: Foundational Literacy and Numeracy, Critical Life Skills, Basic Education, Vocational Skills, Continuing Education. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2132893&reg=48&lang=2
• Education Ministry treats 95% literacy in a State/UT as equivalent to full literacy. https://www.pib.gov.in/FactsheetDetails.aspx?Id=151049&reg=48&lang=1
• Ladakh was declared fully functionally literate on 24 June 2024, the first such administrative unit. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2028457&reg=48&lang=2
Mains Recall (CSE 2027):
• [Provision] Literacy is defined as the ability to read, write and compute with comprehension, plus critical life skills such as digital and financial literacy. https://www.pib.gov.in/FactsheetDetails.aspx?Id=151049&reg=48&lang=1
• [Data] Ten States/UTs declared themselves fully literate between 2024 and 2026, including Mizoram, Goa, Tripura and Himachal Pradesh. https://www.pib.gov.in/FactsheetDetails.aspx?Id=151049&reg=48&lang=1
• [Example] Tripura became fully literate at 95.6%, up from 20.24% in 1961. https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2139103&reg=48&lang=2
• [Way forward] The scheme runs on volunteerism with content in local languages; sustain it towards full literacy by 2030 under NEP 2020. https://dsel.education.gov.in/en/scheme/nilp
Relevance & Revision Note:
[Prelims 2027] Under ULLAS, what literacy level in a State/UT counts as full literacy? (95%).
[Mains 2027] Adult literacy remains an unfinished agenda. Evaluate ULLAS's volunteer-based model in achieving functional literacy. (GS2, 10)
